Every AR multiblock needs a controller face, and the §6Control Circuit Board§f is what marks it. Without one, no machine assembles.

Good news: this is the §6only AR circuit§f with a §6vanilla crafting table§f recipe. Redstone, Nether Quartz, copper dust, wood slab, and iron plate in a 3x3 grid. No multiblock required, so you can mass-produce it early.

You right-click the control circuit with a Wrench to assemble the multiblock preview. One board per machine, and AR players routinely need 50+ of them. Set up autocrafting with AE2 or Refined Storage so you never run out mid-build.

§ePS:§f A stack of 64 fits in a single Drawer unit. Keep a stash near your assembly area.
